steps.en: Install it and give it a judge model (OpenAI key by default, or your own model)
steps.zh: 安装，并给它一个评审模型（默认 OpenAI key，也可换自己的）

steps.en: Write a test: input, your app's actual output, expected output, plus a metric and threshold
steps.zh: 写测试：输入、应用实际输出、期望输出，再配指标和阈值

steps.en: Run the test file, locally or in CI
steps.zh: 在本地或 CI 里跑测试文件

steps.en: Asks the judge model to score each output against the criteria, from 0 to 1, with a reason
steps.zh: 让评审模型按标准给每条输出打 0 到 1 分，并写出理由

steps.en: Fails any test whose score is under the threshold, like a failing pytest assertion
steps.zh: 分数低于阈值的测试判为失败，就像 pytest 断言失败

value.en: A prompt or model change that makes answers worse fails the build instead of reaching users
value.zh: 改提示词或换模型让回答变差时，构建直接失败，而不是等用户发现
